name: Menu Parent Selector
description: A field that lets editors pick a menu and a parent link, then displays that link's children; an AJAX endpoint returns parent options per menu.
project_description:
Provides a field that lets editors select a menu and a parent link, then displays its children.

 How to install and use:

 - Enable the module.

 - Go to a content type and add a field of type "Menu Parent Item":

 

 - You can set a default value (optional):

 

 - Go to /admin/structure/types/manage/XXX/form-display and enable the field in the form:

 

 - Go to /admin/structure/types/manage/XXX/display and enable the field:

 

 - Your menu should have a structure like this, a parent item and children items:

 

 - Create or edit a node. Then, select the menu and the parent item:

 

 - Save the changes. The node should show only the links under parent item:
